initialExam.title: Delhi Police SI 2026
initialExam.description: Sub-Inspector recruitment in Delhi Police through SSC CPO examination. Apply through SSC CPO 2026 notification.
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: GI & Reasoning, GK, Quant, English. Paper-II: English Comprehension.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 200Q, 200 marks, 2 hrs. Paper-II: 200Q, 200 marks, 2 hrs.
initialExam.careerGrowth: SI → Inspector → ACP → DCP → Joint CP → Special CP → CP.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply through CPO notification 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Uniform Allowance, Delhi Police specific allowances, Medical
